notes.title: Fixed some bugs + Added a more complete farm!
notes.content:
Hello,

First of all, thank you for the enthusiasm for this first week of HMS! It is heartwarming!

So for this first patch, we corrected a few bugs, notably display bugs, as well as the online scoreboard.

Also, it was pointed out to us that it was a shame not to have more skin for lactomans since the size of the farm is limited to 10 anyway (Thanks Sarah). So our teams are working on more skin, in the meantime we've tinkered with something, I hope you like it!!

More generally, I would also like to take this opportunity to thank Tsunadida endlessly for all the promotion she was able to do for the game on Twitch! (https://www.twitch.tv/tsunadida)

Furthermore, I would like to congratulate our now famous “Riri et son p'tit Ricard” for its almost constant top 1 in the first week!!

Don't forget to join the discord to be informed of future updates!

Biz

notes.title: Official launch date!
notes.content:
"Human Milk Seller," a unique and thought-provoking game, is set to launch on Steam on April 1, 2024. In a dystopian future where humanity is on the brink of extinction, players will find themselves in a world devastated by nuclear fallout, climate disasters, and rampant corporate greed. The game introduces the Lactomans, genetically engineered creatures that produce ultra-nutritious milk, representing humanity's final hope for survival.
As a farmer tasked with tending to these creatures, players will navigate a narrative filled with dark humor and satirical undertones, reflecting on modern society's pitfalls. The game promises a blend of casual gameplay, strategy, and a rich storyline that challenges players to breed and care for the Lactomans while resisting external threats and improving production. 

With its impending release, "Human Milk Seller" is poised to offer a unique gaming experience that combines engaging mechanics with a commentary on capitalism and survival.
